setu.label: SETU
setu.description: Draw a line where you want a bridge of light. Its length and slope follow your finger, so it can also be a ramp. It catches you if you fall onto it.

chhaya.label: CHHAYA
chhaya.description: Draw a V. Your shadow-double runs ahead. Guards chase it, and striking it leaves them dazed.

jwala.label: JWALA
jwala.description: Draw a lightning bolt to hurl fire. Burns smoke-thorns and fells a guard in one hit.

udaan.label: UDAAN
udaan.description: Draw a line straight up to leap high, even in mid-air. Jump first, then cast at the top to reach the highest ledges.

kavach.label: KAVACH
kavach.description: Draw a circle to raise a shield. Spears glance off it and the attacker is dazed.

tarang.label: TARANG
tarang.description: Draw a peak (^) to send out a shockwave. It hurls guards back and shatters cracked stone, which often hides secrets.

bandhan.label: BANDHAN
bandhan.description: Draw a square to bind every guard near you in roots of light. They cannot move or strike for a while.

drishti.label: DRISHTI
drishti.description: Draw a triangle to see through maya: false stones fade and hidden paths appear for a few seconds.
